name: comp-357
title: Titled Tooltip
blurb: A tooltip with a bold title and paragraph body text.
description: Tooltip displaying a larger bold title followed by descriptive body text, all in one compact card.
use_when: Detailed explanations that need a headline and supporting text.
avoid_when: Very short content; the padding and title make it overkill for single-line hints.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only, not keyboard-accessible.
